title: Hanasato Minori — Let's Do A Fan Meeting!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shibuya Okuyama Building - Basement Hall

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Okay, let's start taking everything down! We need to remain focused until the end so that we don't have any accidents.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because an event isn't over until you get home!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sound like an elementary schooler going on a field trip.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: There! Just a little more to go!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll start picking up all the trash around the building!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I'll lend you guys a hand...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Slow down, Minori.
Let's leave it up to the staff this time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you never know when people are waiting for you at the exit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Waiting for me...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You look excited, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, it's not what you think! I was just wondering what it would be like for that to happen, but you're right. We don't want to cause a fuss.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for taking care of this! I'm sorry about not being able to lend you a hand!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: You can count on us, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: We'll make it so that this place shines even brighter than it did before the event!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: We can't let them take all the credit!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yeah, let's get to work!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: We'll be moving some of the equipment now, so please be mindful if you're working by any doors or walkways!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Please bring the mic stands here!
Yes, all at once is fine!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
I'll gather all the bolts and stuff.
We can't be losing any of these.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Thanks! I was just looking for somewhere to put them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa... They're cleaning everything up so fast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they seem to know exactly what they're doing now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Getting through this event seems to have given them all a much-needed boost in confidence.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I have a feeling that they've taken what Minori just said to heart. About how an event's not over until it's actually over...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
Hehe. I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna go help clean up too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Let's see... I'd like to help out somewhere that looks shorthanded... Oh!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(It's Yuina!
Is she trying to move that table by herself? Now's my chance...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yuina, let me help you!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Sure... M-Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Thank you very much, but this is really heavy. I'd feel awful about making an idol carry anything heavier than a mic...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, it's okay! We're the ones that asked our fans to do all this for us, so think of it as me returning the favor!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay!
In that case, I accept!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! We can do this together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... That should be the last of the folding chairs.

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Thank you so much for your help, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I should be the one saying that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you again for helping us out today, Yuina! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
What? No, please...!
Thank you for letting me help out today!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: I'm usually only able to show my support by buying CDs and merchandise, or by cheering during shows...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: But I'm so happy that I was able to directly help you all out like this! It was an incredible experience!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It was...?!
You're okay with seeing your favorite idols carry around folding chairs like this...?

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Of course! It was a great experience because I got to see you doing everything you could for us...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: You did everything you could to give us hope.

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually started to tear up a little when the event started because I was so moved.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yuina...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: So I'd like to help you out and show my support again if I ever get that chance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay... Yeah! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't really know what things are gonna be like next time, but I promise to pay it forward and do everything I can to spread more and more hope!
